visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a red cheongsam stands against a traditional Chinese wooden screen background. To her left, a large red scroll displays text about the lunar calendar and lucky signs. On the right, red lanterns hang. A cartoon snake character is visible in the bottom left. (2) The woman speaks directly to the camera, using hand gestures to emphasize points. The text on the left scroll transitions to list the first custom: 'All-family cleaning'. (3) The scene continues with the woman explaining the second custom: 'Prepare New Year dishes'. The visual remains static with a medium shot focus on the speaker. (4) The woman moves to the third custom: 'Worship the Heavenly God'. She brings her hands together in a prayer-like gesture. (5) A new graphic appears on the left overlay titled 'Luck Opening Tips', listing the first tip about purifying the body with herbal water. (6) The second luck tip is displayed: 'Burning incense for blessings'. The woman continues her professional delivery with warm facial expressions. (7) The woman provides final advice about harmony during the festival and getting a haircut. She concludes with a thumbs-up gesture. (8) The video ends with a full-screen red graphic featuring a cartoon snake, New Year greetings, and a website URL.

Background music consisting of traditional Chinese string instruments like the Guzheng and Erhu plays steadily at a low volume. (2) As the speaker transitions between different customs, subtle whoosh sound effects are used to synchronize with the visual graphic changes. The BGM remains consistent in its pentatonic folk style. (3) The speaker's vocal pitch remains in a mid-range with positive valence, conveying an informative and friendly mood. No background noise or incidental thuds are heard. (4) The audio maintains a high signal-to-noise ratio throughout. Each listed item is punctuated by a slight pause in the voice, while the music provides a continuous emotional bed.
